Subject: Request: latest attack simulation/pen test report for hosted API and secure delivery options

Hi Sofia,

Quick one from our side — Aegis is preparing for an architecture review next week and we need the most recent attack simulation / penetration test report that covers Redwood's hosted API (public endpoints, auth, rate limiting, and multi-tenant controls). Specifically we would like:

- The full report (technical findings and remediation notes)
- A short executive summary we can share with our risk committee
- Confirmation of the test scope (external black-box, authenticated tests, any infra excluded)
- Current remediation status for high/critical items (open, mitigated, projected completion)

We need to receive the report over a secure channel. Preferred transfer options (in order):
1) Password-protected PDF uploaded to an S3 presigned URL with a 24–48 hour expiry (password sent over a separate channel)
2) Azure AD guest link to a protected SharePoint/OneDrive folder restricted to aegisfin.com accounts
3) PGP-encrypted attachment (we can provide a public key)

Could you advise which options you can support, and whether Redwood will redact customer data/PII before sharing? If there's an internal tracker for remediation we'd like to see the current status (spreadsheet is fine).

Thanks — if we can get this by EOD Wednesday (12/16) that would be ideal.

Best,
Lynn Carter
Security Program Manager
Aegis Financial
security@aegisfin.com

Hi Lynn — thanks for the clear list. We can accommodate your request and have a few standard options for secure delivery. High level answers first, details below.

Summary:
- We can provide the full attack simulation report (latest test completed 2026-11-30) and a 1-page executive summary.
- Redwood will redact customer payloads/PII by default; the report contains no customer-request-level data.
- Preferred transfer: password-protected PDF on an S3 presigned URL (we can do 48-hour expiry) plus password shared over a separate channel (SMS or HubSpot secure note).

Available transfer methods (we can do any of the below):
- Presigned S3 URL (recommended): password-protected PDF, 48h expiry, TLS+HMAC on the link. We will also publish a SHA256 checksum and provide password via a separate channel.
- Azure AD guest share: we can create a tenant-restricted guest on SharePoint for aegisfin.com and upload artifacts (requires a short guest onboarding step).
- PGP: we can encrypt with your public key if you'd prefer end-to-end encryption.

Redaction and content:
- We redact customer payloads, query contents, and any customer identifiers. Findings are reproduced with repro steps where required but never include customer data.
- We can include the remediation tracker (spreadsheet) with current status for high/critical issues; the tracker includes target completion dates and owners.

Attachments included for your reference: redwood_attack_sim_summary.pdf (1-page exec summary). I'll prepare the full report and remediation tracker once you confirm preferred transfer method and whether you need the remediation tracker included in the same package.

Options / next steps (please reply with preference):
1) S3 presigned + password (48h) — we will send link + SHA256; password via text to +1 (415) 555-01XX or HubSpot secure note (please confirm which)
2) Azure AD guest share — we will invite the user(s) you specify (list of emails required)
3) PGP — send public key and we'll encrypt the PDF

If you need an executed NDA first, we can route our standard security NDA (DocuSign) — otherwise the presigned upload is faster.

Regards,
Sofia Ivanova
